activities.name: CALCULUS
activities.notes: Closed book, parts 1 and 2 examined separately. Published theory-question lists make the theory half fully predictable.

activities.name: COMPUTER PROGRAMMING, ALGORITHMS AND DATA STRUCTURES
activities.notes: YOU ARE A 2023/24 COHORT STUDENT, so for module 1 you may choose the project-based exam instead of the computer-based test. Module 2 stays a written paper with two independent minimums.

activities.name: KNOWLEDGE REPRESENTATION AND REASONING
activities.notes: Final mark is the MEAN of the two module scores, so a strong module can carry a weak one. Both publish solved papers.

activities.name: PROBABILITY AND STATISTICAL INFERENCE
activities.notes: Computer-lab written exam. The published exercises are explicitly stated to match exam difficulty, and the solved-paper archive is the largest in the plan.

activities.name: THEORETICAL AND QUANTUM PHYSICS FOR AI
activities.notes: Two modules examined independently at two universities. The Kiro courses exist but their contents stay hidden until you self-enrol; enrol to see past papers before judging the effort.

activities.name: ETHICS, LAW AND AI
activities.notes: 12 CFU but essay/discursive rather than technical. Three lecturers; confirm which parts are examined together.

activities.name: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE FOR COMMUNICATION AND MARKETING
activities.notes: Non-technical Bicocca course. Self-enrol on Kiro to reveal the material; effort is a guess until then.

activities.name: MACHINE LEARNING, ARTIFICIAL NEURAL NETWORKS AND DEEP LEARNING
activities.notes: The exam is take-home style coding submitted on the session date, not a closed-book paper. Part 1 + part 2 register as one overall grade - read the registration notice.

activities.name: BRAIN MODELLING
activities.notes: Thin Kiro presence. Casellato teaches it at Bicocca; check the Bicocca e-learning page.

activities.name: COGNITIVE PSYCHOLOGY
activities.notes: Not a soft option: the oral is compulsory and gated behind 12/25 on the written. The quiz bonus needs in-class attendance, so it is not available to you retroactively.

activities.name: STATISTICAL MODELLING
activities.notes: Thin Kiro presence: material is likely distributed elsewhere by D'Angelo. Ask for past papers directly.

activities.name: COMPUTATIONAL LOGIC
activities.notes: Five straight years of past papers with solutions - the most directly practicable exam in the plan.

activities.name: TEXT MINING AND NATURAL LANGUAGE PROCESSING
activities.notes: Negative marking on the closed questions - guessing costs you. Otherwise well covered by samples.

activities.name: WEB AND SOCIAL MEDIA SEARCH AND ANALYSIS
activities.notes: Same track as Information retrieval, so material overlaps with the IR project. Self-enrol to confirm whether it is project-assessed too.

activities.name: DATA MINING AND KNOWLEDGE EXTRACTION
activities.notes: Best value in the plan: the three assignments carry up to 12 of the 30 points before you sit anything. Do them and the written part only has to deliver the remainder.

activities.name: FUZZY SYSTEMS AND EVOLUTIONARY COMPUTING
activities.notes: Highly patterned: the same question types recur with published model answers. Strong candidate for a fast 18.

activities.name: ORGANIZATION THEORY AND DESIGN
activities.notes: Free-choice exam outside the AI degree, so its dates follow its own course, not the BAI session calendar. Check its appelli in Esse3.

coursework_in_parallel.name: FINAL EXAM
coursework_in_parallel.notes: A report on a topic explored in a stage, project work or laboratory, supervised by a course lecturer. Must be uploaded in PDF/A one week before the graduation day.

coursework_in_parallel.name: INFORMATION RETRIEVAL AND RECOMMENDER SYSTEMS
coursework_in_parallel.notes: A real build, not a token exercise - but no exam to sit, and it overlaps heavily with Web and social media search.

coursework_in_parallel.name: LABORATORY OF MACHINE LEARNING
coursework_in_parallel.notes: Nine report submissions, no exam. Deadline-driven, so it can run in parallel with exam preparation.

coursework_in_parallel.name: PROJECT WORK
coursework_in_parallel.notes: F-ALTRO activity. Agree the brief with a supervisor; can overlap with the final report.
